set_windy.description: Sends a command to the motor indicating whether it is windy or not

send_command.name: Send RTS command
send_command.description: Sends any raw command using the RTS protocol

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Number of times the command will be repeated. Leave it empty, or set it to 0, to use the repeat count configured on the motor

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: The direction of the step (Up / Down)

step_size.name: Step size
step_size.description: The size of the step (127 being the maximum)

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Number of times the command will be repeated. Leave it empty, or set it to 0, to use the repeat count configured on the motor

reboot.name: Restart
reboot.description: Triggers a restart of the ESPSomfy-RTS device

backup.name: Backup
backup.description: Triggers a backup of the ESPSomfy-RTS device configuration. The file holds the WiFi passphrase in clear text, it is stored owner-only in the Home Assistant configuration directory

restore.name: Restore
restore.description: Send a stored backup back to the device and restore the chosen sections. The device reboots once it is done.

sections.name: Sections
sections.description: Which parts of the backup to restore.

backup.name: Backup file
backup.description: Name of the backup file to restore. Leave empty to use the most recent one.

backup_failed.message: Backup of {name} failed: the device is unreachable or did not return its configuration

restore_failed.message: Could not restore the backup to {name}. The device is unreachable, or it rejected the restore.

room_limit.title: Not enough rooms on {device}
room_limit.description: The area **{area}** could not be added as a room on {device}: the board already has its maximum of 16 rooms. Delete a room on the board, or move the shade back to an area that already has its room.

room_name_clash.title: Two areas share one room name on {device}
room_name_clash.description: The areas **{area}** and **{other}** both become the room **{room}** on {device}, which keeps 20 bytes per name (an accented letter takes two). The shades of **{area}** were not moved on the board. Rename one of the two areas so that they differ within their first 20 bytes.

organization_conflict.title: Rooms differ between {device} and Home Assistant

init.title: Keep which side?
init.description: {count} shade(s) of {device} are in a room on the board and in another area in Home Assistant. Nothing has been changed yet: choose the side to keep, the other one is aligned on it.

menu_options.board: Keep the rooms of the board
menu_options.home_assistant: Keep the areas of Home Assistant

abort.not_loaded: The board is not loaded, try again once it is connected.

init.title: Repeat the orders of {shade} more?
init.description: {device} sends each order for **{shade}** with {current} repeat(s); {recommended} are advised from what the board measures. With too few repeats, one lost frame is one ignored order, and the shade only answers "sometimes". Submit to set {recommended} repeats on the board.

abort.not_loaded: The board is not loaded, try again once it is connected.
abort.cannot_connect: The board did not accept the change, try again once it is reachable.

weak_link.title: Weak radio link to {shade}
weak_link.description: The guided measurement of **{shade}** is only {margin} dB above the noise of {device}. More repeats rarely save such a link: move the board or its antenna, or add a repeater, then measure again from the RF diagnostics page of the board.

firmware_outdated.title: Firmware {version} on {device}
firmware_outdated.description: {device} runs firmware {version}. ESPSomfy-RTS Companion is made for the ESPSomfy-RTS v4 firmware: queued orders sent as one continuous train, listen before transmit, radio diagnostics, updates from GitHub. Install it from your browser with the link below, after a backup of the board.

group_mixed.title: Group {group} also moves a gate or a garage door
group_mixed.description: The group **{group}** of {device} holds window coverings together with a gate or a garage door: one command moves them all. Home Assistant therefore treats the whole group as a gate or a garage door, and voice assistants ask for confirmation before opening it. If that is not what you want, remove the gate or the garage door from the group on the board.

mqtt_duplicates.title: {device} also publishes its shades over MQTT
mqtt_duplicates.description: The MQTT discovery of the board is on, so Home Assistant shows every shade twice: once from this integration and once from MQTT. Turn off "Publish Discovery" on the MQTT page of the board ({url}), then delete the duplicate MQTT devices.

unexpected_restart.title: {device} restarted on its own
unexpected_restart.description: The board started at {time} after a crash (reset reason: {reason}). If it happens again, note what was going on at that moment and open an issue with the diagnostics of this integration. Ignore this repair once you have read it.

command_received.name: A shade received a command
command_received.description: Starts when the board sees a command for a shade, from Home Assistant or a physical remote.

source.name: Source
source.description: Only start for commands from this source. Home Assistant is a command this integration sent; the board itself is its web page or MQTT.

remote_address.name: Remote address
remote_address.description: Only start for commands from this remote address (a dedicated remote or a group).

once_per_press.name: Once per press
once_per_press.description: A remote that drives several shades reports one press for each of them: run once per press instead.

progress.press_remote: Press a button of the remote to add, near the board. Waiting 30 seconds.

not_heard.title: No new remote heard
not_heard.description: The board heard no new remote within 30 seconds. Check that the remote is in range and that its battery works, then submit to listen again. A remote already linked to a shade on the board has its device already and is not offered here.

name.title: Name the remote
name.description: Remote {address} heard. Give it a name: it becomes a device in Home Assistant, with one trigger per button.

abort.not_loaded: The board is not loaded, try again once it is connected.
abort.firmware_too_old: Adding a remote needs firmware 4.3 or later on the board.
